Regional airspace and flight operations

09 Sep 2026 12:00 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3) Latest Update

Travel advisory: Self-Declaration Form (Air Suvidha) for guests traveling to India

In accordance with official directives issued by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, all guests—both Indian and international nationals—traveling to India must complete a mandatory Health Self-Declaration Form (SDF) before boarding.

This advisory is part of health screening measures in relation to the Ebola outbreak. Submitting your details online helps ensure a seamless, reassuring arrival experience.

  • Online submission: Complete the mandatory declaration on the official Air Suvidha portal.
  • Submission window: The portal is accessible up to 72 hours prior to scheduled departure.
  • Required details: The form captures 21-day travel history, exposure history, and symptom declaration.
  • Physical verification: Download and carry a printed or digital copy to present at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration Counter upon arrival. If online completion is unavailable prior to travel, a physical declaration must be submitted before immigration clearance.
  • Health protocol: Any guest with suspected symptoms must report directly to the Airport Health Officer or Health Desk before immigration clearance. If symptoms develop within 21 days of arrival, seek immediate medical care and notify authorities of your travel history.
  • Support contacts: For inquiries, contact the National Helpline Number at 1075 or email idsp-alert@nic.in.
Complete Air Suvidha declaration
01 Jul 2026 14:19 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Operational update: Flight schedule adjustments through October 2026

As part of Saudia’s continued commitment to its valued guests and its dedication to keeping them informed of operational developments, while enhancing schedule stability and reliability.

Please be informed that all flight cancellations and rescheduling have now been updated and reflected across booking systems through the end of October 2026.

Accordingly, you may proceed with booking and ticket issuance, while continuing to monitor flight status through our official channels for any further operational updates.

Track flight status
29 May 2026 15:25 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Operational update: Partial resumption/cancellation of flights

Saudia will partially resume/cancel operations to multiple destinations.

We will offer an alternative flight, where possible, with no additional cost. Moreover, the alternative should also be extended up to 14 days from the original date on Saudia (SV) flights, including routing to the nearest airport within the same country or within 300 miles.

Guests are advised to check the status of their flights before heading to the airport. Further updates will be shared through Saudia's official channels.

13 Mar 2026 00:23 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Operational update: Dedicated flight status page

Saudia is committed to keeping its guests informed of operational developments related to the current situation.

A dedicated flight status page is available for guests to check the status of their flights.

Track flight status
10 Mar 2026 17:16 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Operational update: Further extension of flight suspensions

Saudia continues to monitor developments in real-time with relevant authorities to ensure the safety of our guests and crew. Here are the latest operational updates:

  • Amman, Kuwait, Abu Dhabi, Doha, and Bahrain: Flight suspensions extended until 12 Mar 2026 (23:59 GMT), with some exceptional flights operating.
  • Moscow and Peshawar: Flight cancellations remain extended until 15 Mar 2026.

The situation is under constant review, and further updates will be published on our official platforms as they become available.

08 Mar 2026 15:39 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Operational update: Suspension extension and partial resumption of Dubai flights

Saudia continues to update its flight operations based on the current situation to ensure the safety of our guests and crew. Here are the latest updates:

  • Amman, Kuwait, Abu Dhabi, Doha, and Bahrain: Flight suspensions extended until 10 Mar 2026 (23:59 GMT).
  • Moscow and Peshawar: Flight cancellations extended until 15 Mar 2026.
  • Dubai: Partial resumption of flights operating on a limited schedule.

The operational schedule is under constant review. Further updates will be published as soon as they become available.

06 Mar 2026 22:14 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Partial resumption of flights to and from Dubai

Saudia has partially resumed flight operations to and from Dubai starting Saturday, 07 Mar 2026, operating the following services:

Outbound flights:

  • SV596 - Riyadh to Dubai
  • SV588 - Jeddah to Dubai

Inbound flights:

  • SV597 - Dubai to Riyadh
  • SV589 - Dubai to Jeddah

Flights will operate on a limited schedule initially, with additional services expected to be restored progressively. Guests may book available flights through saudia.com and the Saudia mobile app.

Further updates will be shared through Saudia's official channels.

06 Mar 2026 17:52 Saudi Arabia Time (GMT+3)

Suspension of regional flights extended

Saudia announces the extended suspension of flights to and from Amman, Kuwait, Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Doha, and Bahrain until 23:59 GMT on Sunday, 08 Mar 2026, due to the ongoing situation.

Meanwhile, the cancellation of flights to and from Moscow and Peshawar will be extended until Sunday, 15 Mar 2026.

Saudia is evaluating the gradual resumption of some flights and will announce updates as soon as operational decisions are finalized. The safety and security of our guests and crew remain our highest priority.

Guest advisory

  • Please check your flight status before heading to the airport. Saudia urges guests not to proceed to the airport unless their flights are confirmed.
  • Saudia continues to notify guests of any updates via the contact details linked to their bookings.
  • If your flight is cancelled, please contact your travel agency to rebook. If you booked directly with Saudia, please contact us.
  • For the latest news and real-time travel updates, follow Saudia on our official social media channels or via saudia.com.

Flexible options

Guests with affected bookings may choose from the following:

  • Free date change: Change your dates with no extra charges (subject to seat availability) within 14 days of Saudia resuming services on affected routes.
  • Journey continuation: If your journey includes a connection through Jeddah or Riyadh and onward travel is temporarily unavailable, you may:
    • Resume your journey once services reopen.
    • Be reaccommodated on an alternative Saudia routing.
    • Choose the "Travel later" option to keep your ticket protected with no fees.
  • Cancellation & refund: Request a refund without any cancellation fees by contacting us.
  • Support: Our call centers and sales offices have extended support hours.
    Contact us | Saudia Offices
